acceptance_predicates.description: Development source and artifact staging remain within explicit aggregate quotas.
Timeout, quota, scan, and staging failures terminate and reap the process group and remove temporary roots.
Published executable and artifact trees use private permissions and reject unsafe entries.
Successful and replacement activation publish a complete executable/provenance pair or restore the prior pair.
Development runs do not block on missing authentication, signatures, or key management.

definition_of_done: Bounded staging implementation is merged on protected ASB main.
Independent review, hosted checks, and exact-main post-merge workflows pass.

outputs.description: Quota-bound, private, cleanup-safe development artifact staging.

gates.description: Focused tests, fmt, clippy, and diff checks pass.
Independent review, hosted checks, and post-merge workflows are green.
